steps.input:
source3='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ref = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    if not ref:
        return out
    r0, c0 = min(r for r,c in ref), min(c for r,c in ref)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r,c in ref}
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row) - {1, 4}
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        offsets = {(r-dr, c-dc) for r,c in pts for dr,dc in shape}
        valid = [(ar,ac) for ar,ac in offsets if all((r-ar,c-ac) in shape for r,c in pts)]
        if valid:
            ar, ac = sorted(valid)[0]
        else:
            # For a noisy fragment, choose the translated stamp with greatest overlap,
            # breaking ties by the closest object/stamp centroid.
            pr = sum(r for r,c in pts) / len(pts)
            pc = sum(c for r,c in pts) / len(pts)
            sr = sum(r for r,c in shape) / len(shape)
            sc = sum(c for r,c in shape) / len(shape)
            def rank(a):
                ar,ac=a
                overlap=sum((r-ar,c-ac) in shape for r,c in pts)
                dist=(ar+sr-pr)**2+(ac+sc-pc)**2
                return (-overlap, dist, ar, ac)
            ar,ac=min(offsets,key=rank)
        for r,c in pts:
            out[r][c] = 1
        for dr,dc in shape:
            rr,cc=ar+dr,ac+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
'''
